method: Each asset was judged against docs/ART_DIRECTION.md by reading its source: shader code, the mesh builder, the synthesis function in tools/audio/synth_bank.py, the glyph code and the cosmetics data.
Visual judgement relies on the Xvfb + llvmpipe level and screen captures recorded in docs/FINAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md (anti-AI-slop audit); those captures are not committed.
Triangle counts come from building the meshes headless on Godot 4.7.2: godot --headless --path game -s ../tools/report/mesh_budget.gd
Audio facts (length, format, import mode, volumes) come from the WAV headers, the .import files and game/data/audio/sound_bank.json.

Not done: no render on a phone GPU or the Mobile renderer on a device, no frame-time or memory measurement per asset, no listening test on a device speaker. The mobile_cost column states static cost, not measurements.
Verdicts: pass = meets the art direction as far as checked; pass_with_note = ships, with a deviation, an unverified point or a known weakness stated in the note.

entries.role: Floor force-field arrows: currents, the launch-pad insert and gravity-well strips.
entries.style: Energy marks (additive, unshaded) for forces, as §4 asks for pads, currents and wells.
entries.scale: Arrow count per strip from the `tiles` instance uniform; wells use span / 1.6 u so arrows keep their size.
entries.perspective: Flat on the floor plane (quads 0.015-0.016 u above it); arrows drawn in UV space.
entries.material: unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, shadows_disabled.
entries.lighting: Intensity 0.55 (currents), 0.45 (pads), 0.2 / 0.12 (heavy / light wells): below the 1.0 glow threshold; only a pad's 0.25 s launch flash (ripple x2) goes above it.
entries.texture: Procedural chevrons from fract(); no image texture.
entries.animation: Drift along `direction` at `speed`: currents 2.0, pads 3.0, heavy wells +3.5, light wells -1.0 (backwards).
entries.readability: Arrow direction is the push direction; heavy vs light wells differ by colour and by direction (§4).
entries.mobile_cost: A few ALU ops per fragment, no texture fetch; additive overdraw limited to the strip.
entries.note: Edges use a fixed UV smoothstep (0.08-0.12), not screen derivatives, so far arrows may alias; not checked on a device.

entries.role: The energy core's body: 19 animated styles (core_styles.gdshaderinc) chosen by the equipped core skin.
entries.style: Energy: the only strong bloom (§1, §2 priority 1); Fresnel rim on every style.
entries.scale: Patterns in object space (obj_pos x 3.2) on a 0.3 u core, so they scale with the core, not the screen.
entries.material: unshaded; HDR intensity 2.4 (Palette.ENERGY_CORE), 1.05 with rim 0.35 in high-key worlds (§3 ink shell).
entries.lighting: Self-lit energy above the glow threshold; the core also carries its own OmniLight3D (CoreView, range 3.4).
entries.topology: n/a: applied to the core form meshes (see mesh.core_forms).
entries.texture: Procedural only (core_styles.gdshaderinc over noise.gdshaderinc): fbm, cells, hashes and analytic patterns; no textures.
entries.animation: TIME x anim_speed (0.6-2.0 per skin), pulse uniform on taps, overdrive flicker sin(20 t) with t = TIME x anim_speed.
entries.readability: Rim plus HDR value keep the core the brightest object on screen.
entries.mobile_cost: Branch on a uniform `style`; styles 0/1/3/7/9 run 4-octave fbm (32 hash calls), 2/6 a 9-cell loop; small screen area.
entries.note: Per-fragment fbm cost not profiled on a phone GPU.

entries.role: Shaft floor: lane surfaces, recessed grooves, lit lips, panel seams, caustics, music beat.
entries.style: Matter, matte panels (§5 floor row); seams recessed and darker, never lit lines.
entries.scale: World units: lanes 1.6 u, grooves 0.035 u, lips 0.012 u, seams every 4 u.
entries.perspective: Object-space coordinates on a 9 x 160 u plane that scrolls with the core.
entries.material: roughness 0.82 (0.62 in grooves), metallic 0.18, specular 0.4; burley + schlick_ggx; no EMISSION.
entries.lighting: Lit by the key light and ambient; lips gain +0.05 albedo on the music beat (0 with reduce motion).
entries.texture: Procedural lines anti-aliased with fwidth; Deep Ocean caustics painted into albedo (since 4d3eb5f).
entries.animation: Seams scroll with distance; caustics move with TIME; beat pulse decays at 3/s.
entries.readability: Grooves show the lanes, seams show speed (§7 foreground).
entries.mobile_cost: Loop over at most 4 lane boundaries; caustic branch only when enabled; covers a large part of the screen.
entries.note: Largest per-pixel surface in gameplay; its cost was not measured on a device.

entries.role: Breakable glass block on High and Ultra: the same chamfered block in glass with fine Voronoi fracture lines.
entries.style: §4 breakable = same block in glass; §5 glass row (tint, fresnel, darker cracks, never glowing).
entries.scale: Fracture cells in object units (xy x 3.2 + z x 1.7): about 0.3 u cells on a 1.13 x 0.86 u block.
entries.perspective: Object space; cracks stay fixed to the block.
entries.material: blend_mix, depth_draw_always; roughness 0.08 (0.5 on cracks), specular 0.75, metallic 0.
entries.lighting: Lit (burley, schlick_ggx); alpha 0.42 + fresnel x 0.4 + crack x 0.3; no emission.
entries.texture: Procedural Voronoi edge (3x3 cell loop with a sin hash); no textures.
entries.animation: None; the shatter is BurstPool debris.
entries.readability: GLASS_TINT #ffb38f (lighter, cooler WARNING) + transparency + dark cracks separate it from solid barriers.
entries.mobile_cost: 3x3 cell loop per fragment on a transparent surface: High and Ultra only (Low and Medium use shader.glass_lite).

entries.role: Core halo and the expanding ring pulses (combo step, launch).
entries.style: Energy, additive billboard; one thin ring per combo step (§9).
entries.scale: Halo 1.5 u, ring 1.3 u (size uniform).
entries.material: unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, shadows_disabled.
entries.lighting: Halo intensity 0.2 + up to 0.18 with combo + 0.2 pulse (below bloom); ring 1.2 x fade.

entries.animation: Ring radius eased over 0.32 s (BurstPool.RING_LIFE); halo follows combo and pulse.
entries.readability: Halo strength is the combo read-out around the core; the ring marks each combo step.
entries.mobile_cost: One quad each; pool of 4 rings; small additive overdraw.

entries.role: Inverted-hull ink outline around the core in high-key worlds.
entries.style: §3: high-key worlds keep light values and rely on the core's ink shell; Graphite ink.
entries.scale: 0.022 u along the normal (about 7 % of the 0.3 u core radius).
entries.perspective: World-space thickness, so it thins with distance like any geometry.
entries.material: unshaded, cull_front, depth_draw_opaque, shadows_disabled.
entries.topology: Reuses the current core form mesh.
entries.animation: Follows the body's scale and spin.
entries.readability: Gives the core a value edge against the light floor (§2 priority 1).
entries.mobile_cost: One extra draw of the core mesh, only while WorldTheme.bright.
entries.note: Only Cloud Factory is high-key; judged on llvmpipe captures only.

entries.role: Energy membranes: phase gates, form gates, portal disc, portal exit disc, finish line.
entries.style: Energy may glow but stays thin and translucent so the shaft reads through (§1).
entries.scale: Scan pattern sin(uv.y x 40) on gates (about 6 bands per height) or sin(r x 22) on discs; sizes are fixed, so density is constant.
entries.perspective: Flat quads standing across the track (gates) or facing the camera axis (portal).
entries.material: unshaded, blend_add, cull_disabled, depth_draw_never, shadows_disabled.
entries.lighting: Intensity 1.15 (ENERGY_MEMBRANE) x (density 0.1-0.32 + edge 0.6): edges reach about 1.0, the body stays under the glow threshold; a ripple adds up to 0.6.
entries.texture: Procedural scan lines and edges; no texture.
entries.animation: Scan scroll; ripple on use; `visibility` fades it once the core is 1.5 u past (the finish opens on completion).
entries.readability: Colour = the phase / form it asks for; the matte arch frames it (§4 gates).
entries.mobile_cost: One additive quad per gate; cheap ALU.

entries.role: Shared procedural noise (hash, value noise, fbm, cells) for core.gdshader and trail.gdshader.

entries.role: Event-only screen effects: chromatic split, distortion ring, coloured edge tint.
entries.style: §9: each effect has one job; no lens flare or motion blur (§6).
entries.scale: Chroma offset 0.8 % x chroma; distortion 1.8 % x shock; edge tint up to 60 % x amount.
entries.material: canvas_item reading hint_screen_texture.
entries.lighting: Edge tint: FAILURE 0.55 on fail, ACCENT 0.25 on perfect, surge colour 0.18 entering a gravity well.
entries.animation: Decays: chroma 3/s, shock 2.2/s, tint 1.6/s; the rect is hidden when all are near 0.
entries.readability: Fail = impact (the only chromatic split), perfect = reward, form change / overdrive = a distortion ring.
entries.mobile_cost: Full-screen pass + screen copy only while active; off on the low preset and with battery saver.
entries.note: Full-screen cost not measured on a device.

entries.role: Tap ripple: flat ring on the floor under the core for every accepted tap.
entries.style: §9 tap row: flat floor ring, 180 ms, form colour; grey (Palette.FOG) when a dash is refused.
entries.scale: 1.4 u quad; ring radius 0.25 -> 1.0 of the half size.
entries.material: unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, shadows_disabled.
entries.animation: Spreads and fades in 0.18 s (TapRipple.LIFE).
entries.readability: Confirms that the tap was accepted, in the colour of what it did.
entries.mobile_cost: Pool of 3 quads; additive.

entries.role: Sky gradient, the flux sink on the horizon, optional sparse stars.
entries.style: §6: the sink is the only large light shape; environment colours pass WorldTheme.quiet first.
entries.scale: Sink at 0.6 of the height; stars on a 110 x 190 cell grid.
entries.perspective: Background laid out from the eye direction in the camera's rest frame (identical to the screen layout at rest), so lean, shake and lane follow turn the view across it; the radiance pass uses the gradient only.
entries.material: Sky shader; radiance (cubemap) pass gets the gradient only.
entries.lighting: Sink core exp(-r x 40) x 1.2 goes above 1.0 and blooms (energy); sink strength 0.75 in high-key worlds.
entries.animation: Static.
entries.readability: Gives the run a direction: the core drops towards the sink.
entries.mobile_cost: RADIANCE_SIZE_32; two exp() per pixel, plus a hash and a third exp() where stars are on.

entries.role: Sparks and prisms (MultiMesh shards).
entries.style: §4: one collectible silhouette, energy colour by role (PRIMARY spark, ACCENT prism, phase colours).
entries.scale: Spark shard 0.11 x 0.30 u, prism 0.18 x 0.46 u.
entries.material: unshaded; intensity 1.6 sparks, 1.84 prisms; value steps with facing (0.55-1.0).
entries.animation: Spin 0.9 rad/s, bob 0.06 u (§8); collect pop 1 -> 1.25 -> 0 in 120 ms (SparkField).
entries.readability: Same silhouette for every collectible; colour states the role.
entries.mobile_cost: One MultiMesh draw call per type for the whole level.
entries.note: Spark height is 0.30 u where §4 says 0.32 u (within the shard family; kept). Prisms carry the orbiting ring (mesh.prism_ring).

entries.role: Energy trail ribbon behind the core; 12 cosmetic styles.

entries.role: The one block primitive: hazards, posts, lamps, pads, plates, rails, ribs, arches.
entries.style: §4 chamfer family: hazards 16 % of the shortest edge (ViewKit.HAZARD_CHAMFER), structure 8 % (CHAMFER_RATIO).

entries.animation: n/a: static mesh.

entries.topology: 28 chamfered parts (twisted blocks use a 16 % chamfer). 1232 triangles, one indexed surface.
entries.animation: Static; scrolls past at run speed.
entries.readability: Environment: rhythm, speed and depth (§7 midground); priority 6, low value.
entries.mobile_cost: MultiMesh: one draw call for 16 ribs; 1232 x 16 = 19712 triangles.
entries.note: Heaviest rib: 1232 triangles x 16 instances (19 712 per frame); not measured on a device.

entries.role: World story silhouette. Neon Core: the turbine rotor of the World 1 boss.
entries.style: §7 background: one story silhouette per world, flat, no detail noise.
entries.scale: Tens of world units (e.g. turbine radius 24.5 u, peaks 18-42 u high) at 150 u distance.
entries.perspective: Far background at 150 u, parallax 0.03 of distance, approach capped at 40 u (SILHOUETTE_MAX_APPROACH).
entries.material: Unshaded StandardMaterial3D, sky_bottom lerped 20 % towards the story accent, fog disabled.
entries.lighting: Unlit flat colour, so it never competes with lit gameplay objects.
entries.topology: Six chamfered blades, hub, and a torus rim (48 x 6) as a second surface: 884 triangles.
entries.animation: Rotates 0.06 rad/s around its hub; the roll is reset when the world changes.
entries.readability: Tells the world's story far away; never in the play space.
entries.mobile_cost: One draw call; triangle count as listed under topology.

entries.role: World story silhouette. Crystal Valley ridge and Frozen Pulse glacier: a mountain range.
entries.style: §7 background: one story silhouette per world, flat, no detail noise.
entries.scale: Tens of world units (e.g. turbine radius 24.5 u, peaks 18-42 u high) at 150 u distance.
entries.perspective: Far background at 150 u, parallax 0.03 of distance, approach capped at 40 u (SILHOUETTE_MAX_APPROACH).
entries.material: Unshaded StandardMaterial3D, sky_bottom lerped 20 % towards the story accent, fog disabled.
entries.lighting: Unlit flat colour, so it never competes with lit gameplay objects.
entries.topology: 7 PrismMesh peaks with rule-based widths and heights: 56 triangles.
entries.animation: Static.
entries.readability: Tells the world's story far away; never in the play space.
entries.mobile_cost: One draw call; triangle count as listed under topology.
entries.note: Ridge and glacier differ only in peak sharpness (0.5 vs 0.62).

entries.role: World story silhouette. Molten Grid chimneys, Cloud Factory towers, Deep Ocean pylons.
entries.style: §7 background: one story silhouette per world, flat, no detail noise.
entries.scale: Tens of world units (e.g. turbine radius 24.5 u, peaks 18-42 u high) at 150 u distance.
entries.perspective: Far background at 150 u, parallax 0.03 of distance, approach capped at 40 u (SILHOUETTE_MAX_APPROACH).
entries.material: Unshaded StandardMaterial3D, sky_bottom lerped 20 % towards the story accent, fog disabled.
entries.lighting: Unlit flat colour, so it never competes with lit gameplay objects.
entries.topology: 6 chamfered columns on one height pattern: 264 triangles.
entries.animation: Static.
entries.readability: Tells the world's story far away; never in the play space.
entries.mobile_cost: One draw call; triangle count as listed under topology.
entries.note: All three use the same heights and positions; only the width differs (5 / 7 / 2.2 u).

entries.role: World story silhouette. Desert Reactor dome, Cyber Garden canopy, Candy Reactor reactor.
entries.style: §7 background: one story silhouette per world, flat, no detail noise.
entries.scale: Tens of world units (e.g. turbine radius 24.5 u, peaks 18-42 u high) at 150 u distance.
entries.perspective: Far background at 150 u, parallax 0.03 of distance, approach capped at 40 u (SILHOUETTE_MAX_APPROACH).
entries.material: Unshaded StandardMaterial3D, sky_bottom lerped 20 % towards the story accent, fog disabled.
entries.lighting: Unlit flat colour, so it never competes with lit gameplay objects.
entries.topology: Hemisphere (24 x 12, 624 triangles); reactor adds a torus with engine-default tessellation: 4720 triangles.
entries.animation: Static.
entries.readability: Tells the world's story far away; never in the play space.
entries.mobile_cost: One draw call; triangle count as listed under topology.
entries.note: dome and canopy build identical meshes; the reactor's torus uses the engine default (64 x 32 = 4096 triangles).

entries.role: World story silhouette. Void Space: the horizon ring (default branch).
entries.style: §7 background: one story silhouette per world, flat, no detail noise.
entries.scale: Tens of world units (e.g. turbine radius 24.5 u, peaks 18-42 u high) at 150 u distance.
entries.perspective: Far background at 150 u, parallax 0.03 of distance, approach capped at 40 u (SILHOUETTE_MAX_APPROACH).
entries.material: Unshaded StandardMaterial3D, sky_bottom lerped 20 % towards the story accent, fog disabled.
entries.lighting: Unlit flat colour, so it never competes with lit gameplay objects.
entries.topology: Torus 44-46 u with 48 rings x default 32 segments: 3072 triangles.
entries.animation: Static.
entries.readability: Tells the world's story far away; never in the play space.
entries.mobile_cost: One draw call; triangle count as listed under topology.
entries.note: 3072 triangles for a far, flat-coloured ring (ring_segments left at the engine default).

entries.role: Barrier: each world's own family of lane blockers (two shapes per world, mixed within a row) with a soft contact shadow.
entries.style: §4 obstacle families: machined block / laser fence, ruby crystals, lava basalt, striped industrial block / drum stack, sea mines, bio pods, ice block / ice spikes, rusted barrels / crate, glyph monolith / obelisk, candy block / lollipop. One cue is shared: a warm warning light.
entries.scale: Every shape fits the lane: at most 1.16 u wide (2 x BLOCK_HALF_WIDTH) and 0.62 u deep, 0.8-1.06 u tall (test_view_hazards.gd checks the bounds of every style).
entries.perspective: True 3D geometry; contact shadow quad (blob) on the floor.
entries.material: Surface 0: hazard.gdshader in the world's body colour and style pattern. Surface 1 (lit styles): emissive warning light in the world's warn colour (energy 2.4, 1.3 in high-key worlds).
entries.lighting: Body lit PBR per style (roughness/metallic/clearcoat from HazardShapes.SURFACES); the warning light and the shader's warm fresnel rim are the only emission (functional lamp, §1).
entries.topology: Flat-shaded chamfered boxes, prisms, cones and low-poly balls in one vertex format; 16-416 triangles per shape (the pair of sea mines is the densest), measured per style.
entries.texture: None; patterns (stripes, lava cracks, glyphs, inner glow, candy, veins) come from the shader in object space.
entries.animation: Rises out of the floor on appear (ease-out, no overshoot, §8); warning light breathes slowly (shader TIME).
entries.readability: Shape and body change per world, the warm warning light and rim never do: anything with that light is a hazard.
entries.mobile_cost: 2 mesh parts per blocked lane (pooled EntityView); two surfaces on lit shapes.
entries.note: Shapes judged on llvmpipe captures of all ten worlds; triangle counts not profiled on a phone.

entries.role: Slider body shared by every world (the world's material makes it its own).
entries.style: §4: rounded sled with a lit warning strip on its leading edge.
entries.material: Surface 0 hazard body, surface 1 warning light (see mesh.barrier).
entries.topology: Two chamfered boxes (88 triangles), two surfaces.
entries.animation: Moves with the sim's slider polynomial.
entries.readability: Same warning strip as every obstacle.
entries.mobile_cost: One mesh part plus track and shadow.

entries.role: Slider: hazard block on a recessed floor track whose length shows its range.
entries.style: §4: sled on a visible floor track, dressed in the world's hazard material.
entries.scale: Block 1.16 x 0.74 x 0.51 u; track 0.16 u wide across the travelled lanes.
entries.perspective: True 3D block; track is a floor quad 0.012 u above the floor.
entries.material: Sled body: hazard.gdshader in the world's style; warning strip on its front edge; track = darkened lane colour, roughness 0.7, metallic 0.3.
entries.lighting: Body lit PBR per world style; the warning strip and rim are the only emission.
entries.topology: Rounded sled (chamfered box, 20 % chamfer) + strip + track quad + blob quad.
entries.animation: Slides with the sim's deterministic polynomial (no overshoot).
entries.readability: The track tells the range before the block moves.
entries.mobile_cost: 3 mesh parts.

entries.role: Pulse gate: a shutter panel between two posts that drops into the floor when open.
entries.style: §4: panel that physically drops into the floor; posts in the structure material.
entries.scale: Panel 1.16 x 0.9 x 0.12 u; posts 0.12 x 1.13 x 0.2 u; lamps 0.1 x 0.08 x 0.1 u.
entries.material: Panel: hazard.gdshader with hazard stripes (pattern 1) in the world's colours. Posts: structure preset. Lamps: off = matte #3a2a20, on = ACCENT emission 2.2.
entries.lighting: The lamp is the one functional light on matter (§1 exception); it blinks before the panel closes.
entries.topology: chamfered_box parts: panel, 2 posts, 2 lamps (5 x 44 triangles) + slot track.
entries.animation: Drops with smoothstep over 0.12 s ramps; lamps blink in the last 0.35 s; material swapped only on change.
entries.readability: Lamp on = closing or closed; panel height = open or shut.
entries.mobile_cost: 6 mesh parts.

entries.role: Breakable: the same block in glass (dash or a full plate stack breaks it).
entries.style: §4 breakable = same block in glass with fracture lines.
entries.material: glass.gdshader (see shader.glass).
entries.animation: Static; breaks into 12 lit debris boxes (BurstPool 'shatter').
entries.readability: Transparent + lighter tint = breakable, not solid.
entries.mobile_cost: 2 mesh parts; transparent sorting.

entries.role: Gate arch spanning all lanes (phase gates, form gates, finish line) with its membrane quad.
entries.style: §4 gates: chamfered arch spanning all lanes; the membrane inside is energy.
entries.scale: Height 1.7 u (ARCH_HEIGHT), posts 0.18 u; width = lanes x 1.6 + 0.6 u; finish arch scaled 1.4 in height.
entries.perspective: True 3D arch; membrane is a vertical quad.
entries.material: Arch: structure preset (matter). Membrane: membrane.gdshader (energy).
entries.lighting: Arch lit and shadow-casting; membrane additive.
entries.topology: 3 chamfered parts = 132 triangles; cached per lane count.
entries.animation: Arch static; membrane ripples and dissolves after the core passes.
entries.readability: Frame = 'a rule applies here'; membrane colour = which phase / form.
entries.mobile_cost: 2 mesh parts (+1 marker or icon).

entries.role: Colour-blind phase marker above phase gates: ring for phase A, diamond for phase B.
entries.style: Shape cue so phase gates differ by silhouette, not only hue (Settings > Colour-blind).
entries.scale: Ring 0.15-0.23 u; diamond = shard 0.22 x 0.5 u; 0.42 u above the arch.
entries.perspective: True 3D; the ring is turned to face the camera axis.
entries.material: core.gdshader style 0 in the phase colour, intensity 1.4.
entries.topology: Torus 24 x 6 (288 triangles) or shard (24 triangles).
entries.animation: Static.
entries.readability: Ring vs diamond = phase A vs B.
entries.mobile_cost: 1 extra part per phase gate, only with the setting on.

entries.role: Form-gate icon: the target form's silhouette spinning above the arch.
entries.style: §4 core family: sphere (HOP), shard (PHASE), capsule (DASH), torus (SURGE).
entries.scale: About 0.34-0.5 u, 0.42 u above the arch.
entries.material: core.gdshader style 0 in the form colour, intensity 1.4.
entries.topology: Sphere 4224, shard 24, capsule 3456, torus 4096 triangles (engine-default tessellation except the shard).
entries.animation: Spins about Y.
entries.readability: Shows which tap meaning the gate switches to.
entries.mobile_cost: Up to 4224 triangles for a 0.34 u icon.
entries.note: Sphere, capsule and torus use the engine's default tessellation (thousands of triangles for a small icon).

entries.role: Portal: matte ring with an energy disc in the entry lane and a floor disc at the exit lane.
entries.style: Matter frame + energy membrane, like the gates.
entries.scale: Ring radius 0.5-0.6 u at 0.62 u height; exit disc 1.1 u on the floor.
entries.perspective: Ring stands across the lane; exit disc lies on the floor 0.4 u ahead.
entries.material: Ring: structure preset. Discs: radial membrane (PRIMARY).
entries.texture: Procedural rings in the membrane shader.
entries.animation: Disc scan rings move; flash on use.
entries.readability: Entry disc = enter here; floor disc = where you come out.
entries.mobile_cost: 3 mesh parts.

entries.role: Floor current: chevron strip across the lanes it pushes between.
entries.style: Energy force on the floor (§4 'a force, like a current').
entries.scale: Strip spans the lanes + 1 u, 1.2 u deep.
entries.perspective: Flat floor quad; leftward currents are mirrored and re-centred over their own lanes.
entries.material: chevron.gdshader (PRIMARY).
entries.animation: Arrows drift in the push direction.
entries.readability: Arrow direction = push direction.
entries.mobile_cost: 1 quad.

entries.role: Shield pickup (hexagonal torus) and magnet pickup (capsule).
entries.style: Pickups: unique silhouettes per interaction (§2 priority 4).
entries.scale: Shield torus 0.2-0.27 u; magnet capsule 0.1 x 0.5 u; float at 0.42 u.
entries.perspective: True 3D; shield turned to face the camera axis, magnet lying sideways.
entries.material: Shield: unshaded SUCCESS x 1.6. Magnet: core.gdshader style 8 (candy stripes) in PRIMARY/SECONDARY.
entries.topology: Shield 6 x 4 torus = 48 triangles; magnet CapsuleMesh at engine default = 3456 triangles.
entries.animation: Bob 0.05 u and spin 1.4 rad/s.
entries.readability: Hexagon = protection, striped bar = attraction; the HUD repeats the shield.
entries.mobile_cost: Magnet: 3456 triangles for a 0.5 u object.
entries.note: Magnet capsule uses the engine-default tessellation (3456 triangles); its stripe pattern is the same shader style as the core_candy skin.

entries.role: Soft contact shadow quad under hazards and plates.
entries.style: Grounds matter on the floor without real-time shadows on every preset.
entries.scale: 1.45 x 0.88 u (half size under plates).
entries.material: Unshaded, alpha, black at 38 %, render_priority -1.
entries.lighting: Drawn contact cue, not lit; key-light shadows add to it on presets with shadows (high, ultra).
entries.animation: Follows sliders.
entries.readability: Anchors objects to their lane.
entries.mobile_cost: 1 alpha quad per object.

entries.role: Launch pad: matte slab with an energy chevron insert pointing down the track.
entries.style: §4: matte slab in the structure material with a PRIMARY chevron insert.
entries.scale: Slab 1.0 x 0.08 x 0.9 u; insert 0.72 x 0.7 u.
entries.perspective: True 3D slab; insert flat 0.006 u above it.
entries.material: Slab: structure preset. Insert: chevron.gdshader (PRIMARY, 0.45, speed 3).
entries.lighting: Slab lit and shadow-casting; insert additive; flashes on launch.
entries.animation: Arrows run down the track; flash x2 on launch.
entries.readability: Force pointing forward = it will throw you.
entries.mobile_cost: 2 mesh parts.

entries.role: Mass plate pickup: matte ballast tile with a thin energy ring.
entries.style: §4: matte ballast (heavy-surge violet, darkened, metallic) with a thin energy ring because it is collected.
entries.scale: Plate 0.46 x 0.07 x 0.46 u; ring 0.30-0.33 u; floats at 0.4 u.
entries.material: Ballast: FORM_SURGE_HEAVY darkened 45 %, roughness 0.45, metallic 0.6. Ring: unshaded violet x 1.6.
entries.animation: Slower bob (1.6 rad/s) and turn (0.7 rad/s) than light pickups: heavy.
entries.readability: Heavy tile = weight you carry; ring = collectible.
entries.mobile_cost: 3 mesh parts.

entries.role: Gravity well: chevron strip across all lanes between two matte rails.
entries.style: §4: chevron strip between matte rails; heavy rushes forward, light drifts back.
entries.scale: Strip = well span x (lanes x 1.6 + 0.3) u; arrows about 1.6 u long; rails 0.05 u high, 0.1 u deep.
entries.perspective: Flat floor quad (y 0.016) turned to run along the track; rails stand on the floor.
entries.material: Strip: chevron.gdshader in FORM_SURGE_HEAVY / LIGHT. Rails: structure preset.
entries.animation: Heavy: forward at 3.5; light: backwards at 1.0.
entries.readability: Colour + direction tell heavy vs light (direction is the colour-blind cue).
entries.mobile_cost: 3 mesh parts; kept until the core passes the far end.

entries.role: Core form silhouettes: ORB sphere, PRISM shard, COMET capsule, SURGE sphere + ring.
entries.style: §4 core family: the silhouette, not the colour, tells the tap meaning.
entries.scale: Core radius 0.3 u; comet 0.25 x 0.93 u; surge 0.23 u sphere inside a 0.40-0.46 u ring.
entries.perspective: True 3D; spins per form; ring wobbles.
entries.material: core.gdshader (body and accent); surge ring uses the accent material.
entries.topology: Orb 32 x 16 = 1088; shard 24; comet capsule 3456 and surge sphere 4224 (engine defaults); ring torus 4096 (default).
entries.animation: Squash/stretch springs (§8): 40 ms anticipation, stretch, one overshoot; implodes 60 ms on fail.
entries.readability: Four distinct silhouettes for four tap meanings.
entries.mobile_cost: SURGE form = 8320 triangles (sphere + ring) for one small object.
entries.note: Comet, surge sphere and surge ring keep the engine's default tessellation; judged on llvmpipe captures only (REQ-026 notes the orb reads as a plain disc and the comet looks muddy there).

entries.role: Core attachments: shield ring, hop direction chevron, orbiting charge shards, plate stack discs.
entries.style: Small functional parts on the core; no decoration.
entries.scale: Shield ring 0.5-0.54 u; chevron 0.16 x 0.12 u at 0.46 u; shards 0.045 u at 0.48 u orbit; discs 0.2 u radius, 0.065 u apart.
entries.material: Shield: unshaded SUCCESS x 1.3. Chevron and shards: accent core material. Discs: ballast (lit, metallic 0.6).
entries.topology: Shield torus 6 x 4 = 48; chevron prism 8; shard 24; disc cylinder 24 sides = 288 triangles.
entries.animation: Shield turns; shards orbit at 2.6 rad/s; a full stack makes the core breathe.
entries.readability: Shield up, hop direction (3+ lanes), charges toward overdrive, carried plates.
entries.mobile_cost: At most 1 + 1 + 8 + 3 small parts.

entries.role: Ground shadow under the core that shrinks and fades as a launch carries it up.
entries.style: §4: a launched core is drawn at its height with a soft ground shadow.
entries.scale: 0.9 u quad; scale 1 / (1 + lift x 0.5).
entries.perspective: Flat on the floor (y 0.008) under the core.
entries.material: Unshaded alpha, black 32 %, render_priority -1.
entries.lighting: Drawn contact cue, not a light shadow.
entries.animation: Follows the core; shrinks with lift.
entries.readability: Height of a launched core above the floor.
entries.mobile_cost: 1 alpha quad.

entries.role: Floor plane carrying floor.gdshader.
entries.style: Matter floor (§5).
entries.scale: 9 x 160 u, recentred on the core every frame.
entries.material: floor.gdshader.
entries.animation: Moves with the core; the shader scrolls the pattern.
entries.readability: Ground and lanes.
entries.mobile_cost: 1 draw; large screen coverage.

entries.role: Atmosphere motes per world (dust, embers, bubbles, snow, sand, stars, puffs, sprinkles, twinkling glitter, rising spores).
entries.style: §7: at most 24 on screen, at most 8 % opacity, each with a reason.
entries.scale: 0.06 u motes (0.035 glitter, 0.07 bubbles, 0.09 spores, 0.4 puffs) in a 11 x 4.4 x 36 u box ahead of the core.
entries.material: Unshaded alpha with texture.soft_dot; colour from world key light or a fixed tint.
entries.lighting: Opacity 5-8 %, clamped at 8 % (AmbientMotes.MAX_ALPHA); glitter twinkles through an alpha ramp under the same cap.
entries.topology: CPUParticles3D quads; count from world data (6-20, clamped to 24).
entries.animation: Drift per type (rise, fall, sideways sand, stars streaming towards the camera).
entries.readability: Dust in the key light, embers, bubbles, snow: the world's air.
entries.mobile_cost: Scaled by the quality preset; off on low and with battery saver.

entries.role: Pooled one-shot bursts: collect, prism, near-miss streak, shatter debris, shield, fail, perfect.
entries.style: §9: each effect has one job and a fixed budget.
entries.scale: Motes 0.05-0.08 u; glass debris boxes 0.13 x 0.08 x 0.03 u.
entries.perspective: Billboard motes; debris are real 3D boxes that tumble.
entries.material: Energy motes: unshaded additive with texture.glow_dot. Debris: lit glass (roughness 0.1), never emissive.
entries.animation: Counts: collect 6, prism 10, streak 5, shatter 12, shield 10, fail 28, perfect 30; scaled down on lower presets, never above budget.
entries.readability: Collect = information, shatter/fail = impact, perfect = reward.
entries.mobile_cost: Fixed pools (1-8 emitters per preset); CPU particles so Mobile and Compatibility match.

entries.role: Trail ribbon geometry: camera-facing strip rebuilt from a ring buffer.
entries.style: Short speed cue behind the core (§9).
entries.scale: At most 1.6 u of points, 0.18 u min spacing.
entries.perspective: Faces the camera; fades near the lens.
entries.material: trail.gdshader.
entries.topology: ImmediateMesh triangle strip of 12-40 points (preset trail_points).
entries.animation: Rebuilt every frame.
entries.readability: Direction and speed of the core.
entries.mobile_cost: Per-frame CPU rebuild of a short strip; 1 draw.

entries.role: Tap ripple quads (pool of 3).
entries.style: §9 tap feedback.
entries.material: ripple.gdshader with a per-instance tint.
entries.readability: Tap accepted (form colour) or refused (grey).
entries.mobile_cost: 3 quads, reused.

entries.role: Prism orbit ring (§4: the prism is the premium shard with an orbiting ring).
entries.style: Thin energy ring, same spark shader as the shard, 75 % of its brightness.
entries.scale: Radius 0.3 u round the 0.18 u shard; tube 0.014 u.
entries.perspective: Tilted 1.15 rad off the floor, spun about Y by the spark shader.
entries.material: spark.gdshader (unshaded, instance colour ACCENT).
entries.topology: TorusMesh 24 x 5 rotated into an ArrayMesh: 240 triangles.
entries.animation: Spins at 1.7 rad/s and bobs with its prism (shared instance order).
entries.readability: Marks the prism as the premium collectible without a new colour.
entries.mobile_cost: One MultiMesh draw for every ring in the level.

entries.builder: MeshFactory.detail(kind) for conduits, pipes, panels, crystals, cables
entries.role: Midground side details on the rib rhythm, one kind per world (art.detail).
entries.style: Chamfered or faceted parts in the structure material (§5, §7 midground).
entries.scale: At x = ±3.95 u, 6 u long, one per rib.
entries.material: Structure preset (structure.gdshader), never emissive.
entries.topology: conduits 264, pipes 264, panels 176, crystals 264, cables 528 triangles.
entries.animation: Static.
entries.readability: Environment richness at low value; stays outside the lanes.
entries.mobile_cost: One MultiMesh draw (16 instances); cables 528 x 16 = 8448 triangles at most.
entries.note: Triangle cost measured headless; not profiled on a device.

entries.role: Soft round mask for contact shadows, the core ground shadow and atmosphere motes.
entries.style: Analytic radial gradient: never a hard square sprite.
entries.scale: 64 x 64 px; scaled by the quad that uses it.
entries.material: White -> transparent; tinted by the material.
entries.texture: Smooth gradient; no visible pixels at the sizes used.
entries.animation: n/a.
entries.readability: Soft edge = shadow or mote, not an object.
entries.mobile_cost: 64 x 64 GradientTexture2D: one cached copy for motes and the core shadow; ViewKit builds one more per world for the blob material.

entries.role: Radial glow mask for burst motes.
entries.style: Analytic radial gradient for energy motes.
entries.material: White -> transparent; tinted by the particle colour ramp.
entries.animation: n/a.
entries.readability: Round energy mote.
entries.mobile_cost: One 32 x 32 GradientTexture2D per BurstPool.
entries.note: Duplicates the soft dot at a lower size instead of sharing ViewKit.soft_dot_texture().

entries.role: Volume slider grabber (Settings).
entries.style: Flat Bone disc, matching the toggle knob; no gradient visible (solid to 92 %, then a 1 px edge).
entries.material: Bone, opaque.
entries.texture: Anti-aliased edge from the last 8 % of the gradient.
entries.animation: n/a.
entries.readability: Drag handle of the slider.
entries.mobile_cost: One 28 x 28 GradientTexture2D in the shared Theme.

entries.role: Ink fades at the top and bottom of the main menu over the live attract run.
entries.style: Ink (#0b0e14) to transparent; a functional legibility fade, not a decorative gradient (§10 surfaces stay flat).
entries.scale: 4 x 256 px stretched over 34 % (top, holding 86 % ink to 60 %) and 46 % (bottom) of the screen.
entries.material: Ink with alpha 0.92 -> 0.
entries.animation: n/a.
entries.readability: Keeps the wordmark and controls on ink so the attract run never crosses text.
entries.mobile_cost: Two 4 x 256 GradientTexture2D on TextureRects.

entries.role: Launcher icon: the core in its lane, its trail and the hop arc.
entries.style: Flat shapes in the palette only (INK, GRAPHITE, SLATE, BONE, PRIMARY); no gradients, no halo (since 26c2427).
entries.scale: 512 x 512 SVG with 112 px corner radius.
entries.perspective: Flat 2D; the lane converges to suggest depth.
entries.material: Flat fills.
entries.animation: n/a.
entries.readability: Core + lane + hop arc = the one-tap game.
entries.mobile_cost: 1167 bytes SVG.
entries.note: Checked as a render on llvmpipe (FINAL report); not checked at launcher sizes on device home screens.

entries.role: IconGlyph: every UI icon (42 glyphs) drawn in code on one grid.
entries.style: §10: one system; 24-unit grid, 2-unit stroke, round caps and joins, no fills except status dots and the filled star.
entries.scale: Drawn at the control size (28 px default, 18-72 px in use); stroke scales with size.
entries.material: Single colour per glyph from the palette.
entries.topology: Polylines, arcs and dots on the 24-unit grid.
entries.texture: Vector drawing (draw_polyline / draw_arc, antialiased); no raster icons.
entries.animation: Static; buttons and stars animate the control, not the glyph.
entries.readability: Each glyph is one plain pictogram; icon buttons also carry a tooltip name.
entries.mobile_cost: CPU draw calls per glyph on redraw only.

entries.role: CosmeticSwatch: flat previews of all 9 cosmetic categories, also used for the profile emblem.
entries.style: Same grammar as IconGlyph: 24-unit grid, 2-unit round strokes, item colours on a graphite field; geometric symbols only.
entries.scale: Grid scaled to the control; 1.5 px minimum stroke.
entries.material: Item colours exactly as the data defines them (no 3D colour-space shift).
entries.topology: Circles, arcs, polylines; sky backgrounds as 8 flat bands.
entries.animation: Static.
entries.readability: One look per category; locked items drawn at 45 % opacity.
entries.mobile_cost: CPU draw on redraw only.
entries.note: Core-skin swatches play the skin's real animated style (shader.core_swatch); other categories keep the flat drawing in the item's own colours. Judged on llvmpipe captures.

entries.role: Outfit 400 (latin + latin-ext). Body text and descriptions.
